```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)

# Core libraries
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(textclean)
library(tm)
library(stringr)
library(syuzhet)
library(purrr)
library(kernlab)
library(xgboost)
library(naivebayes)

# Optional ML backends (for SVM, XGBoost, Naive Bayes)
has_kernlab  <- requireNamespace("kernlab",    quietly = TRUE)
has_xgboost  <- requireNamespace("xgboost",    quietly = TRUE)
has_nb       <- requireNamespace("naivebayes", quietly = TRUE)

# Consistent plotting theme used throughout
theme_project <- function() {
theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
theme(
plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)
}

```

```{r}
# Load Dreaddit test data

dreaddit <- fread("Data/dreaddit-test.csv")

# Drop raw text / IDs, keep LIWC and lexical features + label
leak_cols <- c("id", "post_id", "sentence_range", "text", "subreddit")
leak_cols_present <- intersect(names(dreaddit), leak_cols)
dreaddit_model <- dreaddit %>%
select(-all_of(leak_cols_present)) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("no_stress","stress")))


str(dreaddit_model$label)
table(dreaddit_model$label)
dim(dreaddit_model)


# Train/test split
# Identify predictor columns (exclude label)
pred_cols <- setdiff(names(dreaddit_model), "label")
na_counts <- sapply(select(dreaddit_model, all_of(pred_cols)), \(x) sum(is.na(x)))
na_summary <- tibble(variable = names(na_counts), n_na = as.integer(na_counts)) %>%
arrange(desc(n_na))
na_summary %>% print(n = 20)

# Use caret to remove near-zero variance predictors (based on training set only)

set.seed(123)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(dreaddit_model$label, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_raw <- dreaddit_model[train_idx, ]
test_raw <- dreaddit_model[-train_idx, ]

# Identify near zero var on train

nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_raw %>% select(-label), saveMetrics = TRUE)
keep_cols <- rownames(nzv)[!nzv$nzv] # columns to keep

# Always keep label

train <- train_raw %>% select(all_of(keep_cols), label)
test <- test_raw %>% select(all_of(keep_cols), label)

# Preprocess: median impute (if any NAs), center & scale

preproc <- preProcess(train %>% select(-label), method = c("medianImpute", "center", "scale"))
train_pp <- predict(preproc, train %>% select(-label))
test_pp <- predict(preproc, test %>% select(-label))

train_d <- bind_cols(train_pp, label = train$label)
test_d <- bind_cols(test_pp, label = test$label)

# Confirm sizes

dim(train_d); dim(test_d)

```

```{r}
ctrl <- trainControl(
method          = "repeatedcv",
number          = 5,
repeats         = 3,
classProbs      = TRUE,
summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
savePredictions = TRUE,
sampling        = "smote"  # optional: helps with small/imbalanced datasets; remove if undesired
)


```

#### Train GLM baseline (with metrics)
```{r}
set.seed(123)
model_glm <- train(
label ~ .,
data = train_d,
method = "glm",
family = "binomial",
metric = "ROC",
trControl = ctrl
)

pred_glm_prob <- predict(model_glm, newdata = test_d, type = "prob")[, "stress"]
pred_glm_class <- predict(model_glm, newdata = test_d)

cm_glm <- confusionMatrix(pred_glm_class, test_d$label, positive = "stress")

roc_glm <- roc(
response = test_d$label,
predictor = pred_glm_prob,
levels = c("no_stress", "stress"),
direction = "<"
)
auc_glm <- auc(roc_glm)

cat("\n=== GLM Metrics (Dreaddit) ===\n")
print(cm_glm)
cat("AUC (GLM):", round(auc_glm, 4), "\n")

```

```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(
fpr = 1 - roc_glm$specificities,
tpr = roc_glm$sensitivities
), aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) +
geom_line() +
geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
labs(
title = "ROC Curve - GLM (Dreaddit)",
x = "False Positive Rate",
y = "True Positive Rate"
) +
theme_project()

```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
model_rf <- train(
label ~ .,
data      = train_d,
method    = "rf",
metric    = "ROC",
trControl = ctrl,
ntree     = 500
)

pred_rf_prob  <- predict(model_rf, newdata = test_d, type = "prob")[, "stress"]
pred_rf_class <- predict(model_rf, newdata = test_d)

cm_rf  <- confusionMatrix(pred_rf_class, test_d$label, positive = "stress")
roc_rf <- roc(test_d$label, pred_rf_prob, levels = c("no_stress", "stress"))
auc_rf <- auc(roc_rf)

cat("\n=== Random Forest Metrics (Dreaddit) ===\n")
print(cm_rf)
cat("AUC (RF):", round(auc_rf, 4), "\n")

```

```{r}
if (has_kernlab) {
set.seed(123)

# small grid to reduce runtime

svm_grid <- expand.grid(C = c(0.25, 1), sigma = c(0.01, 0.05))
model_svm <- train(
label ~ .,
data     = train_d,
method   = "svmRadial",
metric   = "ROC",
trControl= ctrl,
tuneGrid = svm_grid
)
pred_svm_prob  <- predict(model_svm, newdata = test_d, type = "prob")[, "stress"]
pred_svm_class <- predict(model_svm, newdata = test_d)
cm_svm  <- confusionMatrix(pred_svm_class, test_d$label, positive = "stress")
roc_svm <- roc(test_d$label, pred_svm_prob, levels = c("no_stress","stress"))
auc_svm <- auc(roc_svm)
cat("\n=== SVM Metrics (Dreaddit) ===\n"); print(cm_svm); cat("AUC (SVM):", round(auc_svm,4), "\n")
} else {
message("[kernlab not available] Skipping SVM.")
}

```

```{r}
if (has_xgboost) {

# small tune grid for speed

xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
nrounds = c(100),
max_depth = c(3,5),
eta = c(0.05, 0.1),
gamma = 0,
colsample_bytree = c(0.7),
min_child_weight = 1,
subsample = 0.8
)
set.seed(123)
model_xgb <- train(
label ~ .,
data = train_d,
method = "xgbTree",
metric = "ROC",
trControl = ctrl,
tuneGrid = xgb_grid
)
pred_xgb_prob  <- predict(model_xgb, newdata = test_d, type = "prob")[, "stress"]
pred_xgb_class <- predict(model_xgb, newdata = test_d)
cm_xgb  <- confusionMatrix(pred_xgb_class, test_d$label, positive = "stress")
roc_xgb <- roc(test_d$label, pred_xgb_prob, levels = c("no_stress","stress"))
auc_xgb <- auc(roc_xgb)
cat("\n=== XGBoost Metrics (Dreaddit) ===\n"); print(cm_xgb); cat("AUC (XGBoost):", round(auc_xgb,4), "\n")
} else {
message("[xgboost not available] Skipping XGBoost.")
}
```

```{r}
# ======================
# Initialize model_results BEFORE NB, SVM, XGB append
# ======================

model_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("GLM", "Random Forest"),
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_glm$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  F1 = c(
    cm_glm$byClass["F1"],
    cm_rf$byClass["F1"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    auc_glm,
    auc_rf
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add SVM if trained
if (exists("cm_svm")) {
  model_results <- rbind(
    model_results,
    data.frame(
      Model="SVM",
      Accuracy=cm_svm$overall["Accuracy"],
      F1=cm_svm$byClass["F1"],
      AUC=auc_svm
    )
  )
}

# Add XGBoost if trained
if (exists("cm_xgb")) {
  model_results <- rbind(
    model_results,
    data.frame(
      Model="XGBoost",
      Accuracy=cm_xgb$overall["Accuracy"],
      F1=cm_xgb$byClass["F1"],
      AUC=auc_xgb
    )
  )
}

```

```{r}

)
pred_nb_prob  <- predict(model_nb, newdata = test_d, type = "prob")[, "stress"]
pred_nb_class <- predict(model_nb, newdata = test_d)
cm_nb  <- confusionMatrix(pred_nb_class, test_d$label, positive = "stress")

auc_nb <- auc(roc_nb)
cat("\n=== Naive Bayes Metrics (Dreaddit) ===\n"); print(cm_nb); cat("AUC (Naive Bayes):", round(auc_nb,4), "\n")
} else {
message("[naivebayes not available] Skipping Naive Bayes.")
}
```

```{r}
# Base ROC list

roc_list <- list(
GLM   = roc_glm,
RF    = roc_rf
)

if (exists("roc_svm")) roc_list[["SVM"]]    <- roc_svm
if (exists("roc_xgb")) roc_list[["XGBoost"]] <- roc_xgb
if (exists("roc_nb"))  roc_list[["Naive Bayes"]] <- roc_nb

# Plot first ROC, then add others

cols <- c("GLM" = "blue", "RF" = "red", "SVM" = "purple",
"XGBoost" = "darkgreen", "Naive Bayes" = "orange")

first_name <- names(roc_list)[1]
plot(roc_list[[first_name]],
col = cols[first_name],
lwd = 2,
main = "ROC Comparison: GLM vs RF vs SVM vs XGBoost vs NB")

if (length(roc_list) > 1) {
for (nm in names(roc_list)[-1]) {
plot(roc_list[[nm]], col = cols[nm], lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
}
}

legend(
"bottomright",
legend = paste0(
names(roc_list),
" AUC = ",
sapply(roc_list, function(r) round(auc(r), 3))
),
col = cols[names(roc_list)],
lwd = 2
)

```

```{r}
# Safely extract metrics (NA when model not trained)

get_acc <- function(cm) if (!missing(cm)) cm$overall["Accuracy"] else NA
get_f1  <- function(cm) if (!missing(cm)) cm$byClass["F1"]       else NA

acc_svm <- if (exists("cm_svm")) get_acc(cm_svm) else NA
acc_xgb <- if (exists("cm_xgb")) get_acc(cm_xgb) else NA
acc_nb  <- if (exists("cm_nb"))  get_acc(cm_nb)  else NA

f1_svm  <- if (exists("cm_svm")) get_f1(cm_svm)  else NA
f1_xgb  <- if (exists("cm_xgb")) get_f1(cm_xgb)  else NA
f1_nb   <- if (exists("cm_nb"))  get_f1(cm_nb)   else NA

auc_svm_val <- if (exists("roc_svm"))  auc(roc_svm)  else NA
auc_xgb_val <- if (exists("roc_xgb"))  auc(roc_xgb)  else NA
auc_nb_val  <- if (exists("roc_nb"))   auc(roc_nb)   else NA

model_results <- tibble(
Model    = c("GLM", "Random Forest", "SVM", "XGBoost", "Naive Bayes"),
Accuracy = c(cm_glm$overall["Accuracy"],
cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"],
acc_svm,
acc_xgb,
acc_nb),
F1       = c(cm_glm$byClass["F1"],
cm_rf$byClass["F1"],
f1_svm,
f1_xgb,
f1_nb),
AUC      = c(auc_glm,
auc_rf,
auc_svm_val,
auc_xgb_val,
auc_nb_val)
)

model_results

```

```{r}
mend_tweets <- read_excel("Data/Mendeley/Tweet_Contents.xlsx")
mend_nodes  <- read_excel("Data/Mendeley/Nodes_Data.xlsx")
mend_edges  <- read_excel("Data/Mendeley/Edges_Data.xlsx")

# Ensure tweet column

if ("Tweet" %in% names(mend_tweets)) mend_tweets <- mend_tweets %>% rename(tweet = Tweet)

# Sample safely (no undefined 'sample_size')

set.seed(123)
mend_sample <- if (nrow(mend_tweets) > 10000) mend_tweets %>% slice_sample(n = 10000) else mend_tweets

# Cleaning function (robust unicode-aware)

clean_tweet <- function(text) {
text %>%
as.character() %>%
tolower() %>%
replace_url() %>%
str_replace_all("@[A-Za-z0-9_]+", "") %>%
str_replace_all("#[A-Za-z0-9_]+", "") %>%
str_replace_all("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}\\s]", " ") %>% # remove non-letters/numbers
replace_html() %>%
removeNumbers() %>%
removePunctuation() %>%
stripWhitespace()
}

mend_sample <- mend_sample %>%
mutate(clean_text = map_chr(tweet, ~ clean_tweet(.x)))
head(mend_sample$clean_text, 5)


```

```{r}
# Syuzhet sentiment

mend_sample$syuzhet_sentiment <- get_sentiment(mend_sample$clean_text)
nrc_df <- get_nrc_sentiment(mend_sample$clean_text)
mend_nrc <- bind_cols(mend_sample, nrc_df)

# create stress-like indicator

mend_nrc <- mend_nrc %>%
mutate(
stress_score = sadness + fear + anger + disgust,
positive_score = joy + trust + anticipation + surprise,
stress_flag = ifelse(stress_score > positive_score & stress_score > 0, 1, 0)
)

cat("Proportion of stress-like tweets (sample):", mean(mend_nrc$stress_flag), "\n")
summary(mend_nrc$syuzhet_sentiment)


```

```{r}
bhavik <- fread("Data/Bhavik_Mental_Health_Dataset.csv")

bhavik_mod <- bhavik %>%
mutate(
treatment_bin = ifelse(treatment == "Yes", 1, 0),
treatment_bin = factor(treatment_bin,
levels = c(0, 1),
labels = c("no_treatment", "treatment")),
Growing_Stress   = as.factor(Growing_Stress),
Mood_Swings      = as.factor(Mood_Swings),
Coping_Struggles = as.factor(Coping_Struggles),
Social_Weakness  = as.factor(Social_Weakness),
family_history   = as.factor(family_history)
)

table(bhavik_mod$treatment_bin)

```

```{r}
model_bhavik <- glm(
treatment_bin ~ Growing_Stress + Mood_Swings +
Coping_Struggles + Social_Weakness + family_history,
data   = bhavik_mod,
family = binomial
)

summary(model_bhavik)

```

```{r}

confint(model_bhavik)))
or_bhavik
```

```{r}
smmh <- fread("Data/smmh.csv")
str(smmh)
names(smmh)

```

```{r}
smmh_model_df <- smmh %>%
mutate(
avg_time = case_when(
grepl("Less than",  `8. What is the average time you spend on social media every day?`) ~ 0.5,
grepl("Between 1 and 2", `8. What is the average time you spend on social media every day?`) ~ 1.5,
grepl("Between 2 and 3", `8. What is the average time you spend on social media every day?`) ~ 2.5,
grepl("Between 3 and 4", `8. What is the average time you spend on social media every day?`) ~ 3.5,
grepl("Between 4 and 5", `8. What is the average time you spend on social media every day?`) ~ 4.5,
grepl("More than 5", `8. What is the average time you spend on social media every day?`) ~ 6,
TRUE ~ NA_real_
),
distress_index = rowMeans(
cbind(
`9. How often do you find yourself using Social media without a specific purpose?`,
`10. How often do you get distracted by Social media when you are busy doing something?`,
`11. Do you feel restless if you haven't used Social media in a while?`,
`12. On a scale of 1 to 5, how easily distracted are you?`,
`13. On a scale of 1 to 5, how much are you bothered by worries?`,
`14. Do you find it difficult to concentrate on things?`,
`18. How often do you feel depressed or down?`,
`19. On a scale of 1 to 5, how frequently does your interest in daily activities fluctuate?`,
`20. On a scale of 1 to 5, how often do you face issues regarding sleep?`
),
na.rm = TRUE
)
) %>%
filter(!is.na(avg_time), !is.na(distress_index))

summary(smmh_model_df$distress_index)

```

```{r}
cor_smmh <- cor.test(

)
cor_smmh

```

```{r}
# Emotion Radar — Stress vs Non-Stress Groups
library(fmsb)
library(dplyr)

emotion_means <- mend_nrc %>%
  mutate(stress_flag = ifelse(stress_flag == 1, "Stressy", "Non-Stressy")) %>%
  group_by(stress_flag) %>%
  summarise(
    anger = mean(anger),
    fear = mean(fear),
    sadness = mean(sadness),
    disgust = mean(disgust),
    joy = mean(joy),
    trust = mean(trust)
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("stress_flag")

# Prepare max/min scale based on observed ranges
max_vals <- apply(emotion_means, 2, max)
min_vals <- apply(emotion_means, 2, min)

emotion_radar <- rbind(max_vals, min_vals, emotion_means)

radarchart(
  emotion_radar,
  axistype = 1,
  pcol = c("blue", "red"),
  pfcol = c(rgb(0,0,1,0.3), rgb(1,0,0,0.3)),
  plwd = 2,
  title = "Emotion Profile of Stress vs Non-Stress Tweets"
)

legend("topright", legend = row.names(emotion_means),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
# Behavioral Correlation Heatmap — Student Well-being
library(reshape2)

num_students <- students %>%
  select(Avg_Daily_Usage_Hours, Sleep_Hours_Per_Night,
         Mental_Health_Score, Conflicts_Over_Social_Media, Addicted_Score)

corr <- cor(num_students, use = "complete.obs")

corr_melted <- reshape2::melt(corr)

ggplot(corr_melted, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), color = "white", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "red", high = "blue", mid = "white", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Correlation Heatmap — Student Well-being & Digital Behavior",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
# Odds Ratios of Treatment-Seeking Behavior
or_plot <- as.data.frame(or_bhavik)
or_plot$Variable <- rownames(or_plot)

ggplot(or_plot[-1,], aes(x=reorder(Variable, OR), y=OR)) +
  geom_col(fill="darkred") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, linetype="dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title="Odds Ratios of Treatment Seeking (Bhavik Dataset)",
       x="Feature", y="Odds Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()
```
